collisionImplications.note: Existing external collision envelope remains conservative. Recess is visual geometry; docking gameplay and an enterable collision volume require a separate integration change.
collisionImplications.armament: All attachment seats conform to the hull. Articulated weapons use separate component bounds; do not enlarge the ship envelope for firing barrels. Preserve targetable component roles during supervisor integration.

sharedChangesRequired: Install the validated candidate hull through the supervisor.
Use these four lowered heavy-cannon sockets.
Add the 20 Cruiser batteries and 20 PDCs at armament positions, axis/side and exact native Cruiser sizes. runtime-components.js demonstrates their root/yaw/pitch transforms.
Keep all four physical engine sockets; position broad soft glow faces using engines[].glow at the measured nozzle lips.
